text:
Maya (CEO): thanks for joining the post-all-hands thread. drop short questions about hiring, reorgs, or how teams will operate moving forward and we'll answer.
Max (SWE): quick Q  what are these "allocation tokens" managers keep mentioning? how granular are they?
Priya (Head of People): allocation tokens are our way to budget headcount per manager for the quarter. each token = 1 FTE that managers can spend on any role family after submitting a brief business case. tokens are granular to team level but can be swapped with approval.
Noor (PM): swapping tokens  is there a deadline? can I reassign a token from an unstarted hire to a high-priority contract role?
Fiona (People Ops): swap window is open for the first 10 business days of the quarter. yes you can swap to a contractor or different role family; mark as "urgent swap" for expedited finance review.
Max (SWE): if a role is paused, do candidates in pipeline get rejected automatically? we've got 3 offers pending.
Priya (Head of People): no auto-rejects. TA will reach out to managers on pending offers for paused reqs and present conversion options (move candidate to open req, contractor conversion, or hold). please don't ghost candidates.
Jonas (VP Eng): technical note  infra/platform hires are priority because they unlock lower latency and lower per-token cost. hiring decisions will be evaluated against measurable KPIs.
Noor (PM): for internal moves  does someone keep tenure/level when they switch teams during a reorg?
Priya (Head of People): yes  internal moves preserve level and accrued tenure. compensation only changes with explicit manager+employee agreement.
Max (SWE): EU/APAC folks: will hiring focus be US-centric or distributed?
Fiona (People Ops): hires are global. we expect slightly longer cycles in some APAC markets but roles will be posted locally where needed. timezone alignment remains a factor for cross-team hires.
Max (SWE): what about contractors  are we converting a bunch of contractors to FTEs?
Priya (Head of People): selective conversions where there's long-term need and budget. most conversions will be in infra and platform squads supporting runtime.
Noor (PM): any changes to interview loops for critical hires? can we fast-track product-critical roles?
Priya (Head of People): yes  fast-track lanes exist for critical roles: 2 technical interviews + hiring manager + director signoff. target time-to-offer for fast-track is 14 days.
Maya (CEO): overarching goal: be deliberate not frenetic. invest where we can measure impact on latency, cost, or revenue. leadership will publish a short rubric for hiring approvals tomorrow.
hiring-bot: poll created "Do you feel the allocation token process is clear?" options: Yes / Somewhat / No
Fiona (People Ops): follow-ups i'll post after this thread: 1) allocation token one-pager, 2) swap request template, 3) calendar for manager office hours.
Max (SWE): thanks  helpful. appreciate the concrete swap window.
Maya (CEO): thanks all  we'll keep this thread updated and run a deep-dive office hour for managers next Monday.
